task: routes-preserved-57 (follow-up, narrow: officially preserved historic old-road lines)
role: research only (no code, no repo change, no bash, no browser window, no sub-agent, no outbound message)
outcome: 0 lines secured. 0 files downloaded or read. Stop-on-first-real-file never triggered.
scopeThisRun: Only checking whether 산림청 / 국가유산청 / 국립공원공단 / 지자체 (and the national walking-trail platform) publish an official GPX/KML/GeoJSON/SHP LINE for a currently preserved-and-managed historic old road (문경새재, 대관령 옛길, 죽령 옛길, 십이령 보부상길 등). Max 4 candidates.
hardRules: A modern hiking/walking trail is NOT accepted as a 역로 by inference. The official provider must itself identify the line as an 옛길 / preserved old-road segment and state the historical relation.
Designation polygons, waypoint points and 역참 lists must not be turned into road centrelines.
No modern routing engine to connect points.
If a file could not actually be read, it does NOT count as downloaded/geometry-verified.
Login / API key / payment / contacting staff = stop and record as not obtained.
